title: Install reusable furniture sliders and move a side table
instruction:
Fit a reusable slider under each leg, then slide the table into the outlined destination.
Leave it standing on all four sliders and let go.
setup: A 350 x 350 x 350 mm LACK-style side table, estimated 1.8 kg, with 50 mm square feet at 300 mm centre spacing and a 30 mm tabletop. Four separate round reusable sliders are 88.9 mm in diameter, estimated 13 mm thick and 20 g each: 9 mm cushioned upper face (86 mm usable diameter), 2 mm plastic backing and 2 mm felt underneath. A secured 800 x 1100 x 10 mm polyurethane-oak panel rests on the stock YAM station table, with cutouts around the unchanged arm mounts. In station coordinates, the panel top is z=0.7575 m; the table starts bare-footed at (x,y)=(0.320,0) m. Loose sliders start foam-up at (0.170,+/-0.280) and (0.340,+/-0.280) m. A flat, noncolliding 400 mm square destination is centred at (0.520,0) m. Both stock arms start in their native ready pose.
scoring: Final-state credit is 0.1 per foot on a distinct upright slider, up to 0.4. All four projected foot corners must lie at least 2 mm inside the usable foam edge; the lowest foot-to-pad gap and pad-to-floor gap must each be within +/-0.5 mm. Pads must be within 5 degrees of upright, the table within 3 degrees, and all feet on the panel. Credit requires both grippers at least 50 mm clear, no robot support, and 2 seconds with at most 2 mm translation and 1 degree rotation. Full score 1.0 additionally requires the entire tabletop inside the marked square and a continuous segment with at least 150 mm net table displacement while all four feet stay on the same four sliders. Any loss of qualified support restarts that segment; carrying or upending earlier in the trial is allowed.
run_limit: 6000 control actions at 20 Hz (300 seconds), including all positioning and installation.
fidelity: Product-scale 350 mm table and 88.9 mm sliders; mass, construction and friction are estimates. Foam is a rigid high-friction approximation; compression and shear are uncalibrated. Continuous static floor mesh; contact-only furniture/pads. Stock YAM geometry, gains, limits and 14D actions. One fixed-layout demo passed at 480 Hz; doubled-rate insertion failed alignment. Numerical convergence and real-product fidelity are not established.
scores: Dream-1 (dreamlabs/dream-1-beta): 0.0 in 6000 actions, one genuine hosted episode; scripted demo: 1.0 in 5838 actions. Both independently rescored. SDK renewed expired sessions 124 times; stable-session performance is not established. Details in README.
context: Install reusable floor protectors on a full-size household side table, then move it on those supports. The installation and transport depend on two different contact interfaces: the foot stays on the cushioned upper face while the felt underside slides over the finished floor.
reset_notes: Reusable objects; restore the bare-footed table, four loose foam-up pads and stock ready arm poses to the stated layout. No consumed materials.
